sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Manifest, project and quote checks
sections.what: Builds the manifest and checks counts, dates and quote links for every project, including that no budgets, locations or dates are invented. Also checks specific milestones for named projects.
sections.why: Likely reason: a wrong date or number from a report would be shown to users as fact.
sections.watch_out: This block is long, and a small edit to one project can fail many lines at once.

sections.name: attrs
sections.title: Financial note checks
sections.what: Checks specific spend and financing notes for named projects, to confirm qualifiers such as excluded costs are kept.
sections.why: Qualifiers change what a number means, so dropping them would mislead.
sections.watch_out: The patterns match exact wording, so rewording a note fails the test.

summary: Checks that the real-estate report import gives nine projects and eighteen documents with correct dates and quotes, and that no budgets, locations or dates are invented.
purpose: Stops wrong dates, invented budgets or dropped attributes from entering the database through this import.
why: Likely reason: the import comes from a written report, so the test checks that each fact is tied to its source.
how: Builds the manifest and checks counts, dates and unique links. For each project, checks there are no error-level issues, that attributes are kept, that no budgets, coordinates or completion dates are invented, and that quotes are tied to documents. Then checks named milestones and financial notes, and that the output is the same on a second run. Ends with exit code 0.
inputs: The real-estate report manifest and association modules, run from the repository root.
outputs: One PASS line with counts, then exit code 0.
risks: Counts, dates and wording are hardcoded. The process.exit call at the end means nothing after it runs.
debug: If counts fail, check the manifest. If an invented figure appears, check the mapping code. Changing the report requires updating these expected values.
